what: When opened, the cover over the panel raises a 000 strength line and a 1px accent line by the ready fractions (.34 · .72 · 1), starting after .25s at .35s intervals, each over .6s expo.out. Once full, the button row fades in from transparent over .7s after .15s. It only lifts when a button is pressed — the top and bottom rows and the button go over .25s, after .05s the numbers and lines rise 24px over .4s, after .15s the cover vanishes over .45s power2.in and fires fx:enter (the pressed button’s data-choice)

options.step · gap · start: Climb length per step · gap between steps · first-step delay (s), default .6 · .35 · .25
options.rise · wait: Button reveal length · wait after fully filled, default .7 · .15
options.[data-fx-part=counter·line·actions·chrom: Intensity number · accent color line · button row · small top and bottom lines (several) · enter buttons (several, data-choice records what was chosen)
options.fx:open: Send it to the element and it steps through without a button
options.steps · gap · start: Rise length per cell, gap between cells, first cell delay (seconds), defaults .6 · .35 · .25 — the in-site Brand copy uses .6 · .15 · .05
